s01127.summary: Chief Rahimi examines a body in the planetarium and seals the dome with suspects present.
Oyelaran says there were no footprints at ten; Rahimi finds fresh muddy prints.
The prints lead to Sunny's seat; she denies they are hers and Rahimi demands everyone's shoes.

s00043.summary: Skip Hadley presses rookie Winnie to fix her delivery while Archie brags about 1971.
The teams are called, a broadcast hiccup resolves, and Hadley tells Winnie to throw the last stone.
Archie watches the team step onto the ice and lifts an untouched glass.

s01885.summary: Elias visits Chiara's hot studio and they laugh over the heat.
Elias steps close, molten glass drips, and they fall in a heap.
Chiara checks a burn on his jaw and the moment turns charged.

s02339.summary: The Ferrywoman counts five shadows on the dock under the lantern's voice.
She orders them aboard and covers one shadow's unpaid coin.
The ferry drifts off as the lantern dims and she softly warns of the cold.

s01722.summary: Ex-boyfriend Cal arrives at the laundromat at 3 a.m., upsetting Marisol and Nkechi.
Teddy steps between Cal and Marisol, holding her prom dress.
Cal drops his keys and sits, and Marisol gives him one dryer cycle to speak.

s00602.summary: Wizard Alberich and apprentice Thistle bicker over tea while dragon Umbra sighs.
Umbra explains the mountain holds as long as it breathes, and they tease each other.
Thistle steadies the coughing Alberich with water, then serves tea to all three including Umbra.
The sun rises over the ice and they sit in silence.

s01172.summary: A tense table-tennis match on a rocking ferry reaches ten all.
Ruslan takes the lead while the onlookers fidget and Akiko stays unblinking.
Akiko loses her paddle, Nadia returns it, and Akiko ties the score.
Ruslan offers a handshake and Big Ed urges Akiko to take it.

s00820.summary: Ingrid readies the last stone in a curling hall deep in a salt mine.
Ingrid throws and Bash sweeps frantically.
Destiny arrives to say the shift bell rang an hour ago; Ingrid keeps watching the stone.

s00438.summary: Cordelia pockets a glass vial from a trunk while theater manager Ferdinand watches.
Inspector Grimsby arrives and eyes the trunk.
A scuffle in the dark breaks the vial and leaves the three in a standoff.

s00358.summary: The army bakers knead and bake their quota by six.
A general's aide reports the convoy turned back and the bridge gone.
Molly insists on baking forty loaves as the captain leaves and the humming stops.

s00109_1.summary: Grandson Felix and Wilhelmina fish in an ice hut, and he says he likes it here.
A fish bites, then the line goes slack with a bare, polished hook.
The water ripples and a pale round shape with a face rises under them.
Wilhelmina drags Felix back as a pale creature hauls into the hut and the heater dies.

s02107.summary: Nurse Adwoa tends a failing child by satellite phone with Dr. Kwan's guidance.
She gives the last dose, holds the boy's hand, and his oxygen rises.
Adwoa rests her forehead against the cot as rain drums on.

s01661.summary: Dr. Lehmann starts an MRI on Niamh, who feels the scanner looking back.
He spots a dark shape on the scan and tells her only they are nearly done.
Niamh asks what he sees; he stays evasive before coming to her side.
Both say something is there; Niamh asks to be told in the room and Lehmann agrees after one more sequence.

s02177.summary: June and Leo mop a drained pool as Mrs. Abernathy insists they clean the deep end.
A gurgle from the drain and a child's humming rise as June approaches the grate.
The grate rattles, wet handprints walk toward them, and they flee.
Mrs. Abernathy calmly admits everyone knows, saying the thing is hungry when lonely.
The prints fade, the light dies, and laughter echoes from the drain.

s01274.summary: Weary expedition members shelter in an ice cave as their weather window closes.
They debate leaving injured Bjorn and settle on packing up to walk out.
A distant rotor thrum makes everyone look up.

s01715.summary: Estelle joins her father Clarence at the diner counter.
Clarence admits he sold the farm and Estelle storms up before sitting again.
He covers her hand and the waitress silently brings two slices of pie.

s01887.summary: Four teens wait on a curb while the driver tends the smoking bus.
Tobias fetches the water jug and Ngozi teases him about holding the book upside down.
Mei-Lin gently suggests Raff's dad isn't coming, and the others quiet.
Plumley fixes the bus and Raff takes a last look at the empty road before boarding alone.

s00836.summary: Inspector Agnes questions the staff in the blacked-out planetarium about a dead man.
A radio report says he died of electrocution, and Balthazar muses on irony.
Janitor Jamal wanders in with a bucket and a report notes a wet mop at the scene.

s00172.summary: A dripping stranger comes about a debt before the queen and a knight.
She lowers her hood and Bram recognizes Wrenna, the daughter he left under the roots.
Her acorn sprouts and wilts; the queen forgives the debt but she only came to see the tree.

s01770.summary: A curling team in a salt mine awaits Odalys's decisive throw.
She throws and the sweepers race beside the stone as Wren watches.
The stone settles, nobody cheers, and Ishaan quietly says again.

s01739.summary: Corporal Hadley struggles to write his mother from a ruined bell tower.
Medic Nikolai climbs up and Hadley aims his rifle until he lowers it.
They share biscuits and talk about Hadley's letter saying it's quiet.
Nikolai taps the cracked bell and they wait to see if anyone answers.

s01699.summary: Gregory awkwardly tends his dying mother Lorraine in a hospice room.
Lorraine says she wasn't a good mother and Gregory holds her hand.

s02044.summary: Stranded Cordelia rations water as Tavita watches a silent stranger.
Tavita distrusts the stranger who asks for nothing.
Cordelia offers him water and he reveals he is Matthias, after the same brine lake.
A truck approaches on the horizon; Matthias claims it is his and says they may walk home.

s01513.summary: Five people stand in a tense standoff in a laundry yard at noon.
A sheet billows between them and a bucket tips as nobody speaks.
The sheet drops, Jedediah lowers his gun, and the standoff breaks.

s02364.summary: Roller derby teams line up for the final jam in a packed arena.
The jam erupts as Blanche weaves through the pack and Odalys closes in.
Pru slings Blanche across the line to win the championship.
Odalys offers a hand to Blanche and the referee raises Blanche's arm.

s02519.summary: Baker Gwendolyn arrives late to arbitration claiming a duck delayed her.
Vashti questions the rent arrears and Gwendolyn produces a March deposit ledger.
Gwendolyn explains her late husband kept the books and she wept over the ledger.
Vashti shares her mother's story and says she will rule in her favour.

s00925.summary: Weary soldiers watch a flooded field from a ruined belfry.
A cloth-wrapped struggling dog drifts across the field and they debate whether it is a trick.
Nikolai sends Anneliese and Yusuf to rescue it and remarks that he'd have let it choose.
